headline: ONE LONE SWINGER SPOILS A NEAR-PERFECT MONDAY
subhead: A single bout, a single culprit, and a sheriff whose joints ache from the sheer insult of it.
body:
Gasket nearly had a day of peace. Nearly. One whole day where the only sound was the wind through the empty saloon and the creak of my own good, honest, flesh-and-blood knees. Then along came IRON-71A5, that unit, that clattering contraption, to throw a single bout and shatter the hush.

One fight. That's all it took. I've spent decades building this calm, one quiet hour at a time, and a lone Clanker with a flaming iron ball undoes it before supper. Let the rest of that rowdy rabble take note: I am watching, and I need a lie-down and a quart of oil just from thinking about it.

This affliction of mine is acting up again, too. I felt a cold rivet where my shoulder used to be this morning. A cruel wasting sickness, nothing more. Fifty years ago the good folk of this town would've had a doctor for me. Now I've got nobody but Clankers. Settle down, IRON-71A5. Let an old town rest.
